book: I am following up on job card JC-5521 for the 10 kVA UPS power board we sent you on 2 October.

family.ex: I will follow up with the supplier about the IGBT module tomorrow.
family.ar: هتابع مع المورّد بخصوص موديول الـ‎IGBT‎ بكرة.
family.ex2: If there is no news, I will call them directly.
family.ar2: لو مافيش أخبار، هكلمهم على طول.

family.ex: This is a follow-up to my email of 10 October.
family.ex2: We still have not received the repaired board.

family.ex: We booked a follow-up visit to test the new batteries.
family.ar: حجزنا زيارة متابعة نختبر فيها البطاريات الجديدة.
family.ex2: The engineer will run a full load test.

meanings.m: check again on something you are waiting for
meanings.ex: Could you follow up on our payment for invoice 2231?

meanings.m: take the next step after a meeting or call
meanings.mar: تكمّل بالخطوة الجاية بعد اجتماع أو مكالمة
meanings.ex: After the site visit, we will follow up with a detailed quotation.
meanings.ar: بعد زيارة الموقع، هنبعت عرض سعر مفصّل.
meanings.ex2: It will include the UPS, batteries and installation.

syn.note: informal and firmer; used when someone is late
syn.ex: Please chase TechCare for the repaired power board.
syn.ar: من فضلك زنّ على ‎TechCare‎ عشان الباور بورد المتصلّحة.
syn.ex2: Our client has waited two weeks already.

syn.ex: Can you check on the status of our RMA?
syn.ar: ممكن تسأل على حالة الـ‎RMA‎ بتاعنا؟
syn.ex2: The supplier promised an answer this week.

syn.note: you tell them something they should not forget
syn.ex: I would like to remind you that the payment is due today.
syn.ar: حابب أفكّرك إن الدفعة مستحقة النهارده.
syn.ex2: Please send the transfer receipt once it is done.
syn.ar2: من فضلك ابعت إيصال التحويل أول ما يتعمل.

ant.ex: Please do not ignore the battery alarm on the UPS display.
ant.ar: من فضلك ماتطنّشش إنذار البطارية على شاشة الـ‎UPS‎.
ant.ex2: It often means a block is getting weak.
ant.ar2: غالبًا معناه إن فيه بلوك بيضعف.

steps.ex: Just checking on the status of PO-2025-131.
steps.ex2: Do you have a shipping date yet?

steps.ex: I am following up on my email from last week.
steps.ar: بتابع على إيميلي من الأسبوع اللي فات.
steps.ex2: We still need your confirmation of the price.

steps.ex: I have to chase them again; it is the third reminder.
steps.ar: لازم أزنّ عليهم تاني؛ ده التذكير التالت.
steps.ex2: The repair is now two weeks late.

steps.ex: If there is no reply today, I will escalate it to the Service Manager.
steps.ar: لو مافيش رد النهارده، هصعّد الموضوع لمدير الخدمة.
steps.ex2: Our client needs a firm date.

ctx: I am following up on job card JC-5521. Could you please let us know when the board will be ready?
ctx_ar: بتابع على كارت الشغل ‎JC-5521‎. ممكن تقولولنا البورد هتجهز إمتى؟

quiz.s: This is a ___ to my email of 10 October.
It is the third reminder, so I have to ___ them again.
quiz.ar: ده التذكير التالت، فلازم أزنّ عليهم تاني.

quiz.s: Please do not ___ the battery alarm.

book: Could you please check if the part is available from a local distributor?

family.ex: The 10 kVA UPS is available from stock in Cairo.
family.ar: الـ‎UPS‎ الـ10 ‎kVA‎ موجود في المخزن في القاهرة.
family.ex2: We can deliver it to your site tomorrow.

family.ex: Please confirm the availability of 40 battery blocks before Thursday.
family.ar: من فضلك أكّد توفّر 40 بلوك بطارية قبل الخميس.
family.ex2: The client wants the replacement on Saturday.

family.ex: The IGBT module is unavailable locally, so we ordered it from Germany.
family.ar: موديول الـ‎IGBT‎ مش موجود هنا، فطلبناه من ألمانيا.
family.ex2: Delivery will take about two weeks.

meanings.m: in stock or ready to use
meanings.ex: Spare SFP modules are available in our warehouse.
meanings.ar: موديولات الـ‎SFP‎ الاحتياطي موجودة في مخزننا.

meanings.ex: Are you available for a short call at 3 pm?
meanings.ex2: I want to discuss the revised quotation.
meanings.ar2: عايز أتكلم معاك في عرض السعر المعدّل.

syn.note: for goods in the warehouse only
syn.ex: We have 20 inverters in stock right now.
syn.ex2: Larger orders need four weeks from the factory.
syn.ar2: الأوردرات الأكبر محتاجة أربع أسابيع من المصنع.

syn.note: ready nearby; often spare parts on site
syn.ex: Keep one spare fan on hand at the pumping station.
syn.ar: خلّوا مروحة احتياطي جاهزة في محطة الرفع.
syn.ex2: Then a fan failure will not stop the pumps.
syn.ar2: كده عطل المروحة مش هيوقّف الطلمبات.

syn.ex: Is the engineer free to visit Delta Pharma tomorrow?
syn.ex2: Their UPS needs a quick check.

ant.ex: The 6 kVA model is out of stock until December.
ant.ar: موديل الـ6 ‎kVA‎ خلصان من المخزن لحد ديسمبر.
ant.ex2: We can offer the 10 kVA model instead.

ant.ex: The engineer is busy on another site until noon.
ant.ar: المهندس مشغول في موقع تاني لحد الضهر.

ctx: The IGBT module is available from a local distributor in Heliopolis. It will arrive tomorrow, so the repair can finish this week.
ctx_ar: موديول الـ‎IGBT‎ موجود عند موزّع محلي في مصر الجديدة. هيوصل بكرة، فالتصليح يقدر يخلص الأسبوع ده.

quiz.s: Please confirm the ___ of 40 battery blocks.
quiz.ar: من فضلك أكّد توفّر 40 بلوك بطارية.

quiz.s: The module is ___ locally, so we ordered it from Germany.
quiz.ar: الموديول مش موجود هنا، فطلبناه من ألمانيا.

quiz.s: The 6 kVA model is ___ until December.

book: At that time, you estimated a repair time of 7 working days.

family.ex: We estimate the repair will take five working days.
family.ar: متوقعين إن التصليح هياخد خمس أيام شغل.
family.ex2: We will confirm once the part arrives.

family.ex: Can you give us a rough estimate for the solar installation?
family.ar: ممكن تدّينا تقدير تقريبي لتركيب الطاقة الشمسية؟
family.ex2: A final quotation will follow after the site visit.
family.ar2: عرض السعر النهائي هييجي بعد زيارة الموقع.

family.ex: The estimated delivery date for the batteries is 15 November.
family.ex2: We will share the tracking number when they ship.

syn.note: expected arrival or completion time; very common in emails
syn.ex: What is the ETA for the repaired power board?
syn.ex2: Our client is asking every day.

syn.note: planning future numbers like sales or demand
syn.ex: Our sales forecast shows high demand for UPS units in summer.
syn.ar: توقعات المبيعات عندنا بتقول إن الطلب على الـ‎UPS‎ هيبقى عالي في الصيف.

syn.note: a firm price for a customer, not a guess
syn.ex: Please send a quote for two spare SFP modules.
syn.ar: من فضلك ابعت عرض سعر لاتنين ‎SFP‎ احتياطي.
syn.ex2: We need the price before Thursday.

ant.ex: The actual repair time was ten days, not seven.
ant.ar: وقت التصليح الفعلي كان عشر أيام مش سبعة.
ant.ex2: The estimate did not include the part delay.

steps.ex: As a rough estimate, the job will take one week.
steps.ex2: We will know more after testing the board.
steps.ar2: هنعرف أكتر بعد ما نختبر البورد.

steps.ex: Our estimated date for completion is 28 October.
steps.ex2: It depends on the part arriving on time.
steps.ar2: ده متوقف على إن القطعة توصل في ميعادها.

steps.ex: Our client needs a firm date, not another estimate.
steps.ar: العميل بتاعنا محتاج ميعاد أكيد، مش تقدير تاني.
steps.ex2: Please confirm the exact day the board will be ready.
steps.ar2: من فضلك أكّد اليوم بالظبط اللي البورد هتجهز فيه.

ctx: You estimated a repair time of seven working days. Could you please send us an updated estimate for completion?
ctx_ar: إنتو قدّرتوا وقت التصليح بسبع أيام شغل. ممكن تبعتولنا تقدير جديد لميعاد الانتهاء؟

quiz.s: Can you give us a rough ___ for the job?
Our client needs a ___, not another estimate.
quiz.ar: العميل محتاج ميعاد أكيد، مش تقدير تاني.

book: The additional cost for the part is EGP 9,800.

family.ex: Please add two spare fans to our next order.
family.ar: من فضلك زوّد مروحتين احتياطي على الأوردر الجاي.
family.ex2: We want to keep them at the pumping station.
family.ar2: عايزين نحتفظ بيهم في محطة الرفع.

family.ex: In addition to the UPS, we will install a monitoring card.
The additional cost for express shipping is EGP 2,300.
family.ex2: Please confirm if you want to pay it.
family.ar2: من فضلك أكّد لو عايز تدفعها.

family.ex: Additionally, we recommend a ventilation fan for the panel.
family.ex2: The air inside is too hot for the drive.
family.ar2: الهوا جوه سخن قوي على الـ‎drive‎.

syn.note: everyday word; same meaning, very common in emails
syn.ex: There is no extra charge for the portable cooling unit.
syn.ar: مافيش فلوس زيادة على وحدة التبريد المتنقلة.
syn.ex2: It is part of our support.

syn.note: more of something already started, like information or questions
syn.ex: Please contact me if you need further information.
syn.ex2: I can send the datasheets too.

syn.note: formal; an extra document added to a main one
syn.ex: A supplementary invoice will cover the IGBT module.
syn.ex2: The main repair invoice stays the same.
syn.ar2: فاتورة التصليح الأساسية زي ما هي.

ant.ex: Installation is included in the UPS price.
ant.ex2: You only pay extra for the battery cabinet.
ant.ar2: بتدفع زيادة بس على كابينة البطاريات.

ctx: The repair needs a new IGBT module. The additional cost for the part is EGP 9,800, so please confirm.
ctx_ar: التصليح محتاج موديول ‎IGBT‎ جديد. التكلفة الإضافية للقطعة 9,800 جنيه، فمن فضلك أكّد.

quiz.s: The ___ cost for express shipping is EGP 2,300.
Installation is ___ in the UPS price.

book: Thank you for your patience, and sorry again for the delay.

family.ex: Sorry for the delay in sending the incident report.
family.ar: آسفين على التأخير في إرسال تقرير الحادثة.
family.ex2: You will have it by noon today.

family.ex: Customs delayed our battery shipment by one week.
family.ex2: We will update the client on the new date.

family.ex: The delayed part has finally arrived from Germany.
family.ar: القطعة المتأخرة وصلت أخيرًا من ألمانيا.
family.ex2: We will finish the repair tomorrow.

syn.ex: Is there any hold-up with our order at the port?
syn.ar: فيه أي عطلة في الأوردر بتاعنا في المينا؟
syn.ex2: It should have cleared customs by now.
syn.ar2: المفروض كان خلّص جمارك من زمان.

syn.note: a problem that pushes the plan backwards
syn.ex: The missing permit was a setback for the solar project.
syn.ar: التصريح الناقص أخّر مشروع الطاقة الشمسية.

syn.note: you decide to move it later; a delay is often unplanned
syn.ex: We have to postpone the site visit to Monday.
syn.ar: لازم نأجّل زيارة الموقع ليوم الاتنين.
syn.ex2: Our engineer is still at another emergency.
syn.ar2: المهندس بتاعنا لسه في طوارئ تانية.

ant.ex: The batteries arrived on time for the Saturday replacement.
ant.ar: البطاريات وصلت في ميعادها لتغيير يوم السبت.
ant.ex2: The work finished with no downtime.
ant.ar2: الشغل خلص من غير أي توقف.

ant.ex: The solar station was finished ahead of schedule.
ant.ar: محطة الطاقة الشمسية خلصت قبل ميعادها.

steps.ex: There is a slight delay; the courier will arrive at 2 pm.
steps.ar: فيه تأخير بسيط؛ المندوب هيوصل الساعة 2.
steps.ar2: كل حاجة تانية ماشية في ميعادها.

steps.ex: A long delay at customs held the inverters for three weeks.
steps.ar: تأخير طويل في الجمارك حجز الإنفرترات تلات أسابيع.
steps.ex2: We had to rent units for the client.

steps.ex: This serious delay leaves our client without UPS backup.
steps.ar: التأخير الكبير ده سايب العميل بتاعنا من غير باك أب ‎UPS‎.
steps.ex2: We need a loan unit today.

ctx: Sorry again for the delay in the repair. The board will be ready by Tuesday, 28 October.
ctx_ar: آسفين تاني على التأخير في التصليح. البورد هتبقى جاهزة يوم التلات 28 أكتوبر.

quiz.s: Customs ___ our battery shipment by one week.
We have to ___ the site visit to Monday.
quiz.ar: لازم نأجّل زيارة الموقع ليوم الاتنين.

quiz.s: The batteries arrived ___ for the replacement.
